sessionStart.description: Set the Cursor data root and plan-canvas state dir, load previous context, and detect the environment

sessionEnd.description: Persist session state and evaluate patterns

beforeShellExecution.description: Shell permission decision. Hook-bypass, tmux, and push policy run once from preToolUse, which can rewrite the command

afterShellExecution.description: Shell completion. PR and build notes are logged once from postToolUse

afterFileEdit.description: Cursor file-edit event. Edit checks run from postToolUse so they are not applied twice. Format and typecheck stay on stop.

preToolUse.description: PreToolUse for every tool. Shell policy stays in this script; Write, Edit, governance, and observe run from the same entry

postToolUse.description: Claude PostToolUse dispatcher with Cursor tool_name, tool_input, and tool_output

postToolUseFailure.description: PostToolUseFailure: MCP health recovery, and Skill failure telemetry

beforeMCPExecution.description: MCP audit logging and untrusted server warning

beforeSubmitPrompt.description: Detect secrets in prompts (sk-, ghp_, AKIA patterns)

beforeTabFileRead.description: Block Tab from reading secrets (.env, .key, .pem, credentials)

stop.description: Batch format and typecheck edits, audit console.log usage, persist session state, notify on stop, and deliver Plan Canvas follow-up
